svg.text: The NIC queue covers a CPU gap mid-frame, but not at the frame start
One session on one CPU core. Blue: its visits; green: its packets; red: a late packet 0; dashed: a visit with nothing to send.
the CPU is away: other work
the packets keep their spacing through the gap
Frame start: the queue is empty, so packet 0 waits for the CPU
visits before the target: nothing to send
the CPU is away: other work
empty: the previous frame is done
packet 0 leaves only when the CPU is back: late
